author: Art
text:
I try to stay away from low timeframes but today the Aussie seduced me... here it goes:

AUDUSD reacting strongly to supply edge on H4.

Finding approximate zone where it will move into on same TF as supply. H4 flip + H4 RBR.

VLTF structure gives indication of move lower.

Have missed it on my initial analysis... but spotted it in time. M1 FL limit (gonna make a post about em... later on) was hit to the pip.

Target being the flip with RBR on H4, have to define the target on lower TF. Seems rational to choose another FL limit. We'll see if it goes there or not

Zoomed VLTF picture - TG.

Order triggered. Approach was compressed. Some negative US news hit the wires.... but let's leave news for the analysts after the fact. Been waiting half a day for this.... 2 big cups of coffee.... got edgy. It took quite a while for price to drop. We'll see if it works out or not.

author: Art
text:
a post about flags... There are so many of them. I feel like they are just hanging in the air. Price very often reacts to them... like today on AUDUSD. It is challenging so far to trade these... especially placing SL (yes there is usually some ignored demand/supply to the left).

Anyway, did not trade it but though it should be tradable.

HTF major swing high:

M1/M5 FL

I see many guys from RTM trading these. takes some guts.. Can't explain why but it feels very not natural.. probably due to lack of reference points to place SL. But the lack of reference points is the reason why it works I suppose.

Anyway, have saved this chart that many saw on RTM FF. Named it ¨Grow A Pair 2.2 -26.2¨ of know what. I was left ¨comment'less¨ after seeing this particular chart.

author: Sean9henry
text:
Very nice entry, Art! In fact, that is my dream entry.

Art wrote: "... There are so many of them. I feel like they are just hanging in the air. Price very often reacts to them... like today on AUDUSD. It is challenging so far to trade these..." --- It so true! I always wondered about this kind of trade, just haven't taken it for exactly the reason you described below. I feel that it happens in very strong momentum uptrends. At least I have seen it frequently enough in AMZN. Thought about just buying at the limit and place a stop 2ATR of the TF beyond, but never got around to well define the HTF scenarios that allow it to happen. Once defined, take 50 of these charts and do the expectancy calculation to see if it works --- of course this is the robot way, not RTM way.

M1/M5 FL

"Can't explain why but it feels very not natural.. probably due to lack of reference points to place SL. But the lack of reference points is the reason why it works I suppose." --- I guess that is how they play us.

Learning to quote, let's see how it works.

Sean.

H4 picture

3. Target is flip + fresh supply
